name: resistance band elevated glute bridge
description: A glute bridge with your feet raised and a band adding resistance. Targets the glutes with a deep range of motion.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet on a bench and a band around your thighs just above the knees.
Bend your knees and place your arms by your sides.
Push your knees out against the band and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.
